always_include.description: When true, this source's content is injected into every support reply prompt as general context.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this knowledge source.

library_ids.description: Replaces the libraries this source belongs to. Omit to leave membership unchanged. An empty list removes it from every library.

name.description: New human label for the source.

text.description: Replacement text. Omit to keep the existing content.
